plugins.name: kattfot
plugins.description: A working template for governed agentic analytics — registered metrics with accuracy tiers and refusal rules (kattfot:query-metric), spine-backed funnel analysis, content-addressed provenance receipts with offline drift checks (kattfot:verify), and self-contained interactive rendering (kattfot:render-chart, kattfot:render-dashboard). Per-user browser OAuth; service accounts refused in code.
